brainwait.window: The subscription quota is used up. Brain waits until {time} (the quota reset), then plans once more as a new call: attempt {attempt} of {maxAttempts}. Nothing is sent before then and no Run exists yet.
brainwait.cancelHint: Esc / Ctrl+C: stop waiting and cancel planning (no Run is created)
brainwait.cli: Subscription quota used up: waiting until {time}, then planning once more as a new call (attempt {attempt} of {maxAttempts}). Ctrl+C cancels; no Run exists yet.
brainwait.monitor.heading: Brain waiting for the subscription quota ({count}) — no Run exists yet
brainwait.monitor.line: {scope} · plan {command} · plans again at {time} (attempt {attempt} of {maxAttempts}) · waiting since {since}
brainwait.monitor.unavailable: Brain quota waits could not be read{detail}
brainwait.monitor.hidden: {count} Brain quota wait(s) in scopes you may not read are not shown
brainwait.monitor.truncated: More Brain quota waits are stored than the monitor reads; the oldest are shown
